title: MHONGOOSE HI data for NGC 1566 / NGC 1672 / NGC 5068 (T9, S2, C-TripleKappa)

single_track_release.verified: The full 17,577,036-byte MHONGOOSE_singletrack.zip already on local disk reproduces the Zenodo md5 EXACTLY. Per-galaxy bundles here were cut from that verified archive.

deep_release.distribution: Google Drive ONLY. mhongoose.astron.nl hosts no file archive of its own - the 'Public Data' page links straight out to Drive. There is no Zenodo/VO/ASTRON mirror of the deep releases.
deep_release.survey_paper: de Blok et al. 2024, A&A 688, A109

angular_weightings.range: 8.2 arcsec (r00_t00, highest res) to 94.2 arcsec (r10_t90, lowest res / most column-density sensitive). This spans the survey's full released resolution range, so a resolution-selection check is fully supported by the MOMENT MAPS.

deep_moment_maps.coverage: ALL 6 angular weightings x ALL 3 galaxies. 47 files per galaxy (6 weightings x 8 products, minus mask.fits.gz for r00_t00 which the survey does not release). 141 files, 1,087,207,875 bytes total, every file magic-byte verified as FITS/gzip.

deep_cubes_low_resolution.coverage: 2 of 5 released cube weightings (r05_t60 and r10_t90) x ALL 3 galaxies. 6 cubes, 888,517,440 bytes, all magic-byte verified FITS and byte-for-byte the size Drive reports.

single_track_moment_maps.coverage: robust 0.5 and 1.5 x ALL 3 galaxies; mom0, mom0_pb, mom1, mom2, chan. 10 files per galaxy.

full_release_index.what: Every file in Deep DR1+DR2+DR3: 1749 entries across all 30 MHONGOOSE galaxies, with Drive id and a direct download URL each. Lets any later lane pull any product without re-crawling.

deferred_not_mirrored.what: 9 of the 15 deep HI CUBES - the three high-resolution weightings r05_t00, r10_t00 and r15_t00, for all three galaxies.
deferred_not_mirrored.why: 42.2 GB for those 9 files alone (43.1 GB for all 15). Sizes were measured exactly, not estimated. Mirroring them would not fit this pass.
deferred_not_mirrored.impact: Moment maps are complete at ALL SIX weightings, so the resolution-selection control is unaffected. Only spectral/cube-level work at the three finest resolutions needs these.
deferred_not_mirrored.how_to_get_them: Each entry below carries a direct download URL. Large Drive files return a >100MB virus-scan HTML interstitial on the first GET - re-request with the hidden form fields (id, export, confirm, uuid) to obtain the real bytes.

traps_encountered: Google Drive returns HTTP 200 with a 340 KB JavaScript shell for a folder URL and a 2.4 KB HTML 'Virus scan warning' page for any file over ~100 MB. Both look like success. Every file here was gated on magic bytes (FITS must begin 'SIMPLE  =', gzip on 1f 8b); 4 mask.fits.gz files were caught and rejected on the first pass and re-fetched through the confirm form on the second.
Folder listings are not in the folder page HTML at all. The server-rendered 'embeddedfolderview' endpoint was used instead to enumerate all 1749 files without an API key.

The r00_t00 CUBES are deliberately absent from the release - the README states they are withheld for size and 'available upon request'. So there are 6 moment-map weightings but only 5 cube weightings. This is a survey decision, not a gap in this mirror.
